attBesluta.text: We like this bulletin board. It’s sturdy, well made. Locks work well. Will purchase another one, when we need it.
Excelente material, cómodo y seguro para publicar documentos importantes y que no se pierdan.

I purchased 24 of these bulletin boards for our condo community, and they are exactly what we needed. Perfect fit for our community! We mounted them horizontally, and the doors open and close smoothly with no issue. The locking mechanism works great for keeping posted notices secure. Shipping was fast, and the overall experience with VEVOR was fantastic. Very happy with this purchase!
Arrived quick and Customer service were very helpful in fixing the small issue real quick A+ will def buy from again
